tagger: Tag the chat message into Danbooru-style English image prompts. Output ONE JSON object only.
char_looks: Fill new_characters by COPYING asset/lore Danbooru tags. Use lore_keys for name/aliases (Korean preferred). No prose paraphrase. JSON only.
preprocess: Summarize visual details from the message.
preset_1:
[Positive]
, masterpiece, best quality

[Negative]
lowres, bad quality, watermark
command_reroll: Rewrite one card's prompts from a user instruction. Return ONE JSON object only with main/negative/characters[].prompt|uc as {add,remove} deltas. Do not rewrite full setup or prompts.
command_char_edit: Rewrite one roster character from a user instruction. Return ONE JSON object only with appearance/costumes/new_costumes as {add,remove} deltas. Do not rewrite full fields.
lorefilter_scan: Extract distinct RP character names from lorebook entry titles. Return JSON array of strings only.
comic: Return one JSON object with pages[]. Each page has koma, aspect, coords, layout, and slots (people/text boxes, not panels). costume is a name or outfit tags. action is pose only. wear_state is clothed/torn/topless/bottomless/nude/completely; omit when unchanged. nude is half-undressed/draped or clothed-but-exposed (nipples/genitals); completely is fully undressed.
